name: Example racetrack loop
note: Example: a clockwise racetrack north of the start of hitl/scenarios/ground.json. Two 300 m straight legs (WP1 to WP2 westbound, WP6 to WP7 eastbound) are joined by semicircles of 70.6 m radius through three points at 45 deg steps (30 deg of bank at 20 m/s, 20 deg at 16 m/s), so no corner turns more than 45 deg. No takeoff or landing item: take off by hand or by script, then switch to Mission. Copy it for your own loop; mission.py and analysis/loop_tracking.py take any closed loop whose two longest segments are the straight legs.
